public_rationale: Supplier earnings cannot establish that suppliers were the only profitable businesses. Midjourney is a material potential counterexample: its founder publicly described it as profitable. But the readable statement concerns 2022, and neither it nor the claim provides a comparable target-period profit measure. Under the required accounting and period rules, the available evidence does not support a firm verdict.
limitations: Unknown accounting basis prevents a supported or contradicted money verdict.
The selected calendar quarter does not match every company's fiscal calendar.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The only companies profiting from AI are those selling infrastructure such as chips.

statement.excerpt: The only companies currently profiting from the AI gold rush are those selling shovels.

our_interpretation: Shovels means chips, cloud compute and supporting infrastructure, following the examples in the post.
The plain reading concerns positive financial profit attributable to AI activity, not merely revenue, funding or share-price gains.
For current financial performance, use the latest completed calendar reporting quarter normally public before the post: October–December 2023. Different fiscal calendars remain a limitation.
The broad industry claim supplies no common accounting basis. Examples of individual companies' earnings do not establish one for every AI business.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable financial records establish profits for infrastructure suppliers and no positive AI-attributable profits among model developers, application sellers or adopters in the target period.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one non-infrastructure company has documented positive AI-attributable profit in the target period on the applicable accounting basis.
